title: Double the wide-screen hero event horizon
outcome: The desktop hero renders a roughly 2x larger central black-hole sphere while preserving the intended left/right text contour and responsive layout.
acceptance: At wide desktop widths, the central black-hole sphere is approximately twice the prior diameter.
Compact and mobile layouts remain usable.
The headline remains three visual lines and the descriptive copy retains its spherical arc.
